text:
alex: Heads-up — seeing repeated tiny-gang evictions in eu-west1 after the rack firmware roll last night.
taylor: noticed a cluster of small pods bouncing between nodes in the same rack.
alex: scheduler keeps sloting them into 'thin-shelves' (2-slot nodes) and they get preempted when a larger job lands.
sam: can you paste an eviction log?
alex: sure, snippet from node-event stream: 
```
Evicted pod ml-train-xyz by preemptor: node=eu-west1-rack-12-slot-2 reason=taint.preemptThresholdExceeded
scheduler_debug: allocated_slots=2->0 requeued after 9s
pod_status: OOM=false network_spike=true
```
taylor: that preemptThreshold looks low for racks with noisy NICs. We're hitting egress/conntrack bursts then draining.
casey: NIC bursts + gang scheduling = ripple. Warm pool and rack reserve config probably insufficient.
ops-bot: @channel autoscaler triggered: +3 nodes in eu-west1-rack-13 at 2026-03-20T22:11Z (scale event id: ae3f4)
alex: cost impact: repeated reschedules add GPU-hours and egress — noticed 18% bump in GPU runtime for ml-inference namespace.
sam: temporary mitigations?
alex: quick wins: 1) raise preempt threshold for racks flagged noisy, 2) prefer compact placement for tiny-gangs, 3) avoid scheduling tiny pods onto 2-slot thin shelves.
taylor: agreed. proposing: increase PreemptThreshold from 0.7 -> 0.85 for racks with NVLink=false, add soft anti-thin-shelf affinity.
casey: also add per-az warm-pool buffer labelled tiny-workload=true and tune warmpool size by historical tiny-gang arrival rate.
sam: need metrics: add eviction.whiplash.count and histogram reschedule_delay_seconds. Quick grep: `kubectl -n kube-system logs -l app=scheduler -c scheduler | grep reschedule_delay`
taylor: config draft: 
```
apiVersion: scheduler.redwood/v1
kind: PreemptConfig
metadata:
  name: rack-noisy-tuning
spec:
  preemptThreshold: 0.85
  thinShelfAvoidance: true
  softAffinity:
    tinyPodSizeThreshold: 8
    weight: 20
  noisyRackLabelSelector:
    matchLabels:
      rack.network_profile: noisy
```
sam: good. add an alert: evictions.whiplash.rate > 5/min for 5m -> page on-call and mute non-actionable slack spam.
casey: for testing I'll spin staging racks with simulated nic bursts and run soak for 3h.
taylor: rollout plan: canary scheduler change to 5% instances in eu-west1 tomorrow 06:00 UTC, monitor evict.whiplash, pack.compaction.rate, and cost.delta. rollback if evictions exceed baseline +10%.
sam: I'll own telemetry/dashboard changes and add the new metrics to the GPU infra dashboard.
alex: ownership: @taylor coordinate canary, @casey update warm-pool + labels, @sam add telemetry & alert, ops-bot to publish autoscaler events into #eng-platform as structured events.
ops-bot: noted. will attach scale events to the thread.
taylor: timeline looks good. I'll open a PR for scheduler config and include benchmark run results.
casey: ping me on the PR for warm-pool selector changes.
alex: thanks all — if canary looks healthy, we'll promote after 24h soak. :thumbsup:
